body:
> Eod · 2026-09-17

Source: `C:\TAG Marketing Claude\Summit Plumbing Pros\EOD Report 2026-09-17.txt`

Thursday. Pipeliners (Sep 16 to 18 UTC) and Summit AZ reports.

# Pipeliners
File: `Pipeliners\EOD Report 2026-09-17.txt`. See [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub).
- Quick wins on 5 pages (Florence, Phoenix, Chandler, Hydro Jetting, Queen Creek): one focus keyword applied to H1, meta, opening and a new question-style section.
- Headings fix: Sun City, Sun City West and Sun Lakes H1s (OTTO fix never matched); /services/ got an H1. Menu labels restored after WordPress renamed them.
- Rank gap fixes C6 to C8 live (Apache Junction H1 via OTTO, FAQ fixes). Review 10/16.
- Published /sewer-smell-in-house/ ("sewer smell in house", 3,650 searches, KD 11) with 7 FAQs; indexing requested. New rule: external links never go to competitors, broken or untrusted sites.
- Incident: a full cache flush plus Search Atlas errors left 34 of 37 city pages served without OTTO (bare H1s, missing schema, old titles). Recovered same day. Fix: OTTO cache now refreshes daily instead of every 30 minutes. New rule: never full-flush the cache, purge single URLs only.
- Organic SEO report saved to the CRM: 30-day Google clicks 60 vs 63; branded up 14 to 21, non-branded down 49 to 39; GBP leads 24 (5 booked jobs worth $27,590), organic 4 (3 booked worth $17,600).
- Rank gap audit: only position #2 is a map-pack slot; organic /mesa/ around 42.
- Blog indexing investigation: 22 posts not indexed because of the Mar 5, 2025 bulk upload (18 of 28 not indexed), thin content (median 665 words), topic overlap and no internal links. 11 merges drafted (not live).

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
File: `Summit Plumbing Pros\EOD Report 2026-09-17.txt`. See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Organic scorecard saved to the CRM: clicks 42 vs 40 (28 days); 23 AZ leads vs 19; GBP brought 13 leads and 7 of 12 booked jobs; organic leads 6 to 3.
- Business hours in page data fixed to Mon to Sat 8 to 5, matching GBP.
- Pricing page (placeholder text) made private.
- Fixed 7 wrong-city sentences on 6 pipe lining pages; 2 drain cleaning descriptions rewritten.
- Crawl of 186 pages: no broken links or missing titles. Added H1s to the blog and 4 category pages, fixed an empty button link and lowercase "az" headings.
- A redirect for `/%3Futm_campaign=gmb` looped the GBP homepage link; caught and rolled back.
- Published "tankless water heater descaling" post (about 5,400 searches); indexing requested.

# Follow-ups
- Pipeliners: Kim to approve the 11 merges and rank gap items C1 to C5, L1 to L2; Scott to confirm the "only licensed ePipe partner" claim and other open questions; dates 9/23 OTTO check, 9/24 city read, 9/30 Buckeye, 10/9 review, 10/15 sewer smell read.
- Summit: decide scope of the "Phoenix... all EAST VALLEY cities" line fix; delete 2 Utah snapshot files in the CRM; 9/24 indexing check; 10/2 review.
